cohort: 580 women with low-risk pregnancies who participated in RMC support groups in Sao Paulo, Brazil
finding: Women engaged with RMC support groups and a transdisciplinary team experienced positive perinatal outcomes, including high rates of vaginal birth, low intervention rates, and high maternal satisfaction.
mod_finding: The VBAC rate was 87.1%, and there was no significant difference in cesarean risk between women with or without a prior cesarean.
